place.en: The Si River bank · The reeds

setup.zh: 回到泗水。你醒来的那片芦苇被割平了，岸上摆着上千根绳子，一头系着石头，一头系着木桩。潜水的人围着火堆烤身子。河水不往下游走，往下沉。
setup.en: Back to the Si. The reeds where you woke have been cut flat, and a thousand ropes lie along the bank, a stone at one end, a stake at the other. Divers warm themselves round the fires. The water does not run downstream — it sinks.

recap.zh: 回到泗水岸，你醒来的芦苇已被割平；上千根绳子沿岸摆开，河水在往下沉。
recap.en: Back on the Si, the reeds where you woke had been cut flat; a thousand ropes lay along the bank, and the water was sinking.

text.zh: 你醒来的地方。……第四鼎就在这水底下。它在往下拉。
text.en: Where you woke. …The fourth cauldron is under this water. It is pulling down.

alone.zh: 你醒来的地方。第四鼎就在这水底下，水在往下沉。
alone.en: Where you woke. The fourth cauldron lies under this water, and the water sinks toward it.

text.zh: 一个潜水的人说：彭城太守要捞周鼎，吕梁已经淹死了三个。要问，去彭城南门看告示。
text.en: A diver says: the governor of Pengcheng means to raise the Zhou cauldron, and three have drowned at Lüliang already. Ask at Pengcheng — the notice is on the South Gate.

exits.means: goes to the town, to Pengcheng, to read the notice

text.zh: 你沿泗水往南走。彭城南门下挤满了人，告示的墨还没干。
text.en: South along the Si. The South Gate of Pengcheng is crowded, and the notice's ink is not yet dry.

exits.means: talks to the divers by the fire, asks what they saw under the water

text.zh: 他说：底下不是泥，是链子，粗得像房梁。绳子一碰上，就有东西往回拽。上一个下去的人，再没上来。
text.en: He says: down there it isn't mud, it's chain, thick as a roof-beam. When a rope touches it, something pulls back. The last man who went down never came up.
A chain. …That is not what holds the cauldron.

alone.en: Whatever that chain holds, it is not the cauldron.

exits.means: dives into the river now, tries to go down alone

text.zh: 你没入水里三尺，水就把你往下拖，比石头沉得还快。你抓住一根绳子爬了回来。
text.en: Three feet under, the water drags you down faster than a stone sinks. You catch a rope and climb back.

text.zh: 别一个人下去。先弄清楚底下是什么。
text.en: Don't go down alone. Find out what is down there first.

alone.zh: 一个人下不去。先弄清楚底下是什么。
alone.en: No one goes down alone. Find out first what lies below.
